subject.gist: Builder Steve pursues a barn-inspired home with Andrew, then looks back in disbelief at the undertaking and pride at the result.

story.text: Steve is a builder who asks Andrew for a Scandinavian barn-inspired home, then watches its materials develop as the design takes shape. The dark approach opens into timber-lined rooms looking out into bushland. He wants the gardens to feel as though they have always belonged here, while Andrew makes room for both large gatherings and a quieter pool-house retreat. Looking back, Steve wonders how and why he started such a huge undertaking. He calls it five years in the making and says he is proud of the result, although the film’s description gives a different duration.
